description: This file defines API route endpoints for managing notes, including CRUD operations, using FastAPI. It sets up routing, dependency injection for the service layer, and route handlers for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes.

methods.name: NoteService _service(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Dependency-injected function to instantiate NoteService with a database session.

methods.name: List[NoteOut] list_notes(svc: NoteService = Depends(_service))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all notes.

methods.name: NoteOut create_note(payload: NoteCreate, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note.

methods.name: NoteOut get_note(note_id: int, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a note by its ID.

methods.name: NoteOut update_note(note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service))
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing note by its ID.

methods.name: None delete_note(note_id: int, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a note by its ID.

ctags.name: create_note
ctags.pattern: /^def create_note(payload: NoteCreate, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service)) -> NoteOut:$/

ctags.name: delete_note
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_note(note_id: int, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service)) -> None:$/

ctags.name: get_note
ctags.pattern: /^def get_note(note_id: int, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service)) -> NoteOut:$/

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^def update_note(note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service)) -> Note/
ctags.signature: (note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service))
